rust_summary: Gated, per-tick bound attack and use button state and vanilla cancellation.
doc_summary: Set MouseButtonsListenedEvent.listened to true in Hooks::mouse_buttons_listened to receive Hooks::mouse_buttons during eligible client ticks. MouseButtonsEvent.buttons reports the held attack and use bindings, including keyboard rebinds. Set cancel_vanilla_attack or cancel_vanilla_use to suppress that vanilla action for the tick; send mod-specific network messages separately. Require hooks @API:mouse_buttons@ or higher.
